Title: Generally Available: Azure Front Door now supports managed certificate for wildcard domains

Body.Content:
Azure Front Door standard and premium profiles now support managed certificate for wildcard domains. Previously, you can only bring your own certificate for wildcard domains on Azure Front Door.  

This enables customers to secure multiple subdomains with a single certificate—ideal for SaaS providers and large-scale multi-tenant applications.  

It brings the following benefits 

  • Simplified Operations: Customers no longer need to manage individual certificates for each subdomain. 
  • Improved Scalability: Wildcard support reduces configuration overhead and accelerates onboarding. 
  • Enhanced Security: Managed certificates ensure automated renewals. 
Learn more.
